conditions: CommonMark 0.31.2 fenced code blocks, starting with a valid opening fence.
limitations: Indentation, allowed closing-line trailing whitespace and info string rules remain subject to their separate stated conditions.

triggers: Publisher correction, specification status change, edition remapping, preserved-byte mismatch or contrary publisher evidence.

statement: In CommonMark 0.31.2 a closing code fence uses the opening fence’s delimiter character and at least as many characters, and the fenced block reaches the end of the containing block or document when a qualifying close is absent.
